# Mopidy answers recorded on a real server

Recorded on 24/10/2026 against two Mopidy servers in Docker (outputs to `fakesink`), with three
sine-wave files generated by GStreamer (`la-440.ogg`, `mi-660.ogg`, `ding.ogg`) and two M3U
playlists (`Morning`, `Apéro`):

- `mopidy-3.4.2.json`: Mopidy 3.4.2, the Debian 13 (trixie) package;
- `mopidy-4.0.5.json`: Mopidy 4.0.5 from PyPI, on the same system.

Each key is the answer to a JSON-RPC call (or to the batch of calls of a reading, in the order of
`STATUS_CALLS` in `src/mopidy/model.js`). The Python tracebacks of the two error answers were
removed. Nothing else was changed.
